one: LLM application development: ship apps in sprints and understand model capability boundaries and the new programming paradigm.
pos: CS 224G is a project course that treats the LLM as a new CPU and explores how to build applications around it. It runs in two-week sprints with industry guest lectures, and suits people who want to ship a demo quickly.
topics: **LLM capabilities and limits**: hallucination, context, cost
**Tools and retrieval**: function calling, RAG, external APIs
**Application architecture**: frontend, backend, streaming, state management
prereq: Programming ability; basic ML/LLM awareness; no research background required.
assess: Two-week sprint assignments plus a final project and guest lectures. Check the current syllabus for details.
who: People who want to build LLM products or startups; product managers, designers, full-stack engineers.
tips: It complements CS 329Z: 224G is product cadence, 329Z is systems and eval. Define the user problem before choosing a model.
